summary: Stdcall 3DNow!-oriented wrapper that flushes MMX state (_m_femms), runs the core routine sub_525E9A(a1, a2, a3), flushes MMX state again, and returns the destination pointer a1.

operations.description: Emits _m_femms() before the computation to clear 3DNow!/MMX state.
Calls sub_525E9A(a1, a2, a3), the core computation routine operating on the three operands.
Emits _m_femms() after the computation to clear MMX state before returning to non-MMX code.

unresolved: Semantics of sub_525E9A (0x00525E9A) and whether it performs a 4x4 matrix multiply are outside this packet.
The _DWORD * type of a2 and the intended element counts of the __m64 operands are unknown.
